items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Here's this band at the Little Club. Prima Chalkman, the orchestra, 1930. ... Same setup, Schilling. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Alto and Clarinet. He played a fine clarinet.

With Schilling, wasn't it with Schilling?
